cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Reverse the Score
cards.instruction: Turn each apparent loss into a new category of victory, then invite comparison on those changing terms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Last in the race, first in appreciating the route. Beat that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. A narrow category. How many wildflowers did you notice?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I also win for variety of attention.

mechanism: A assumes the right to select the scoreboard, turning each evidence of losing into a category A wins and inviting B to compete there.
confusable: Distinguish positive reframing alone from explicitly comparing A and B under newly favorable criteria.
comparison: Race loss becomes route attention and variety; consolation trophy becomes storage grace and modesty.
seedUse: Canonical race and trophy seeds already give A category-setting authority; inspect real comparison and B-driven category changes beyond prefixed stance.
